name: Create a recurring responsibility
description: Validates that a new recurring responsibility can be created from the recurring responsibilities page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the public demo flow in a fresh browser context.
Use Sample controls to open the recipient role.
Navigate to the Care plan recurring responsibilities view.
Click the add recurring responsibility action.
Fill a recurring responsibility name into the responsibility field.
Verify the new recurring responsibility appears in the active rules list.
Verify the recurring responsibility is shown as active.
